criteria.note: The bridge (.warp/tracker_bridge.py) gains a non-LLM PROMOTE RECONCILER reconcile_promotions(adapter, config, store), a SIBLING to reconcile_drafts over the SAME two injected seams. For each intake item it calls the REUSED is_eligible (tracker.py, WARP-1001) - the FULL triple ANDed: assignee == the single configured Agent user AND status in the ready-for-dev set AND resolve_repo yields one known repo - and ONLY for a fully eligible ticket looks up its EXISTING draft by the SAME durable intake_source oracle the draft stage keys on (store.spec_id_for_source(repo, _source_link(item))), then flips that spec draft -> ready via store.promote_spec -> _flip_draft_to_ready. This wires the human validation gate: the ready-status leg is exactly the leg the WARP-1002 draft trigger omits, so only the human's Jira action (move to Approved-for-dev, keep it on Agent) makes is_eligible true and promotes the draft into a claimable frontier unit. Selftest positive confirms an eligible drafted ticket (Agent + 'Approved for dev' + resolvable repo) flips status: draft -> status: ready, and the reference FilesystemSpecStore over a temp dir flips the on-disk draft to ready in place via a FRESH store reading the durable intake_source link. No new parser, no LLM call.

The promote is IDEMPOTENT and FAIL-CLOSED, keyed by the durable intake_source link with NO processed-offset ledger and NO second store. _flip_draft_to_ready flips ONLY when the leading front-matter status is exactly 'draft'; a spec already ready or beyond is a byte-identical no-op (input returned unchanged, promote_spec False, not counted). A not-fully-eligible ticket never reaches the flip (is_eligible short-circuits). A fully eligible ticket whose intake_source has no drafted spec (spec_id_for_source is None) is recorded skipped, not promoted. Selftest asserts a second pass over the now-ready spec records promoted == [] and leaves markdown_for(...) byte-identical (both FakeSpecStore and FilesystemSpecStore), and the no-draft leg records promoted == [], store.count() == 0, the ticket in skipped, then drafting it first makes the SAME ticket promote (non-tautology).

Human control is preserved by the reused is_eligible triple: a draft whose ticket a human reassigned off the Agent, or moved out of the ready-for-dev set, is NOT promoted (is_eligible returns ineligible before the flip), so a human can pull a ticket back from the fleet before it builds. The promote advances ONLY the spec's own draft -> ready gate: _flip_draft_to_ready rewrites only the status line inside the FIRST front-matter fence (the same fence-scoped rewrite as dispatch.py _set_status) and touches nothing else, and reconcile_promotions writes NOTHING back to the tracker (no comment, no status, no reassign - outbound is WARP-1004), so the repository stays the single source of truth (NG5). Selftest teeth: a drafted ticket reassigned to 'a-human' at the ready status is NOT promoted (stays draft), restoring the Agent assignee promotes the SAME ticket; a drafted ticket at 'In Progress' is NOT promoted (stays draft), moving it to 'Approved for dev' promotes the SAME ticket. The promote emits ZERO adapter writes (FakeTracker.writes() == []) and before.replace('status: draft','status: ready',1) == after with exactly one 'status: draft' occurrence.

Gate-tested over the FakeTracker + FakeSpecStore with REAL, non-tautological teeth (scripts/selftest.py, WARP-1003 block): the positive (Approved-for-dev + Agent + resolvable repo WITH a drafted spec) flips draft -> ready; three single-leg negatives each leave the draft unpromoted and still draft - a status not in the ready set, a non-Agent/reassigned assignee, and a ticket with no drafted spec - and each is proven non-tautological (restore the ready status, restore the Agent assignee, or draft the spec first, and the SAME ticket promotes). Idempotency is asserted directly on both FakeSpecStore and FilesystemSpecStore. TEETH PROVEN LOAD-BEARING BY MUTATION: weakening reconcile_promotions from is_eligible (full triple) to draft_candidate (the two-leg draft subset, dropping the ready-status leg) turned exactly the WARP-1003 status-leg cases RED - 'promote negative (non-ready status)' and 'promote non-tautology (status)' - at 1417 passed / 2 failed; git checkout reverted, git diff --quiet clean on tracker_bridge.py, HEAD unchanged at 028b9fe. No live network in the gate.

findings.text: Non-blocking, adversarial edge. In _flip_draft_to_ready the detector regex '^status: *(\S.*?) *$' tolerates zero-or-more spaces after the colon while the rewriter '^status: .*$' requires exactly one, so a malformed 'status:draft' (no space) would be detected as a draft yet the subn would find n != 1 and return unchanged with flipped False. This is out of the shipped path (render_spec_markdown always emits 'status: draft' with one space) and it resolves in the SAFE direction - a no-op, never a spurious promotion - so it is fail-closed, not a defect. A future hardening could align the two patterns' whitespace tolerance.
